events.title: 🌍 Little Bettas speaks your language!
events.summary: 🌍 Little Bettas speaks your language! After a lot of hard work, I'm so happy to announce the final set of languages Little Bettas will have! 🐟💬 ːsteamthisː 15 languages: • English • Español • Català • Français • Norsk • Deutsch • Italiano • Português (Brasil) • Svenska • Dansk • Русский (Russian) • Українська (Ukrainian) • 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese) • 한국어 (Korean) • 日本語 (Japanese) To go with it, the whole game got a brand-new rounded, easy-to-read font that supports every one of these alphabets ✨
